verdict.rationale: Casium's own visa guides cover several pieces of the startup menu. There is an O-1A guide that positions it as an alternative for people not selected in the H-1B lottery, an H-1B guide covering lottery and cap-subject timing, and a TN guide with occupation-alignment advice. Green-card paths are covered through EB-1A and EB-2 NIW self-petition guides, plus a blog post on International Entrepreneur Parole. Choosing a path is handled mainly through a personalized case review that "lays out the pathway ahead" rather than a published comparison. Missing for 10: any E-2 guide, coverage of cap-exempt H-1B routes, an explicit visa-selection framework for founders, and independent corroboration.
